name: Udvaboni-Club-Core
description: A core website and digital platform for Udbaboni Club, designed to present the club’s identity, activities, members, and events in a modern and organized way. This project serves as the foundation for community engagement and online presence.

paragraphs: UBCB-Core is the central web service and database system designed for Udvaboni Biggan Club, Bahubal. It serves as a dynamic portal to manage club registries, track active executive members, and organize event participations seamlessly.
features: Dynamic Registry: Displays all registered club members with their designation and core operational department in real-time.
Event Tracking: A dedicated event tracking system showing which member is assigned to or participating in specific science fests, exhibitions, or tech competitions.
Secure Database: Backed by an optimized database configuration (club.db) to ensure fast queries and safe data storage.
Modern Dark UI: A fully responsive, clean, and user-friendly dark-themed dashboard.
